headline: Midwestern State stand alone unbeaten in the Lone Star Conference
dek: UT Tyler's unbeaten start ended at home to Western Oregon of the Great Northwest. Midwestern State beat Simon Fraser the same day to reach six wins and two draws, and no other Lone Star side is still without a defeat.
displaced_by: results night: UT Tyler's defeat to Western Oregon, the desk's top-ranked result, left Midwestern State the Lone Star's only unbeaten side
